message = FALSE,

fig.width = 10,
fig.height = 6,

1. Data Loading and Cleaning# ---- directories ----

core_dir <- "data_core"
web_dir  <- "data_web"
out_dir  <- "output"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir)

# ---- helpers ----

norm_path <- function(u) tolower(gsub("\?.*$", "", trimws(as.character(u))))
flag_denali  <- function(p) grepl("denali", p, ignore.case=TRUE)
flag_feeder  <- function(p) grepl("avy|avalanche|baker|glacier|rainier|mountaineering", p, ignore.case=TRUE)
first_col <- function(df, choices) { for(c in choices) if (c %in% names(df)) return(c); return(names(df)[1]) }

# ---- packages ----

pkgs <- c("readxl","dplyr","stringr","lubridate","janitor","tidyr",
"ggplot2","forcats","scales","kableExtra")
to_install <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install, dependencies = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# --- data_core loading (Confirmed working by user) ---

trips_path    <- file.path(core_dir, "trips.xlsx")
deposits_path <- file.path(core_dir, "deposits.xlsx")

trips    <- readxl::read_excel(trips_path)    %>% janitor::clean_names()
deposits <- readxl::read_excel(deposits_path) %>% janitor::clean_names()

normalize_country <- function(c) {
if (is.na(c)) return("Unknown")
c <- stringr::str_trim(as.character(c))
lc <- tolower(c)
if (lc %in% c("united states","usa","u.s.a.","us","u.s")) return("USA")
return(c)
}

dest_bucket <- function(x) {
s <- tolower(x)
if (str_detect(s,"denali")) {
if (str_detect(s,"prep") || str_detect(s,"custom")) return("Denali Prep")
else return("Denali Expedition")
}
if (str_detect(s,"avy|crevasse|course|glacier mountaineering|school")) return("Training/Course")
if (str_detect(s,"rainier|baker|adams|shuksan|olympus|hood|forbidden|el dorado")) return("PNW Objectives")
if (str_detect(s,"kili|kilimanjaro|aconcagua|everest|cho oyu|island peak|lobuche|ama dablam")) return("High-Altitude Expeditions")
if (str_detect(s,"trek|wonderland|hike|backpacking")) return("Treks")
return("Other")
}

trips <- trips %>%
mutate(
email_norm      = tolower(str_trim(email)),
country         = vapply(country, normalize_country, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
tripdestination = str_trim(trip_destination),
dest_bucket     = vapply(tripdestination, dest_bucket, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
is_denali       = dest_bucket %in% c("Denali Prep","Denali Expedition"),
age_band        = cut(age,
breaks = c(0,24,29,34,39,44,49,59,120),
labels = c("<=24","25-29","30-34","35-39","40-44","45-49","50-59","60+"),
include.lowest = TRUE),
email_domain    = ifelse(str_detect(email_norm,"@"),
sub(".*@(.*)$","\1", email_norm), NA_character_)
)
# Make generic column names, then parse what we need
names(deposits) <- paste0("col_", seq_along(names(deposits)))

deposits <- deposits %>%
dplyr::filter(!is.na(col_2), !is.na(col_3)) %>%  # has first & last names
mutate(
timestamp = suppressWarnings(lubridate::ymd_hms(col_1, quiet = TRUE)),
first     = str_trim(col_2),
last      = str_trim(col_3),
email     = tolower(str_trim(col_4)),
source    = str_trim(col_6)
) %>%
dplyr::filter(str_detect(email,"@"))

source_bucket <- function(s) {
s_low <- tolower(ifelse(is.na(s),"",s))
if (str_detect(s_low,"internet search|google|bing|seo"))                return("Organic Search")
if (str_detect(s_low,"online advertising|advertising"))                 return("Paid Media")
if (str_detect(s_low,"social|instagram|facebook|youtube|tiktok"))       return("Social")
if (str_detect(s_low,"club|association") & str_detect(s_low,"referral")) return("Club/Association Referral")
if (str_detect(s_low,"shop|company") & str_detect(s_low,"referral"))     return("Shop/Company Referral")
if (str_detect(s_low,"referral"))                                        return("Personal Referral")
if (str_detect(s_low,"newsletter|email"))                                return("Owned Email")
if (str_detect(s_low,"podcast|into thin air|edge of the map|book"))      return("PR/Content Hook")
if (s_low == "" || s_low == "other" || s_low == "nan")                   return("Unspecified/Other")
return("Unspecified/Other")
}

deposits <- deposits %>%
mutate(source_bucket = vapply(source, source_bucket, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
month = format(timestamp, "%Y-%m"))

joined <- deposits %>% left_join(trips, by = c("email" = "email_norm"))
joined$is_denali <- ifelse(is.na(joined$is_denali), FALSE, joined$is_denali)

# --- data_web loading (FIXED FILE/COLUMN NAMES) ---
# Load Data from data_web folder (Updated File Names)
landing           <- read.csv(file.path(web_dir, "landing_pages.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
landing_organic   <- read.csv(file.path(web_dir, "Google_organic_search_traffic.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
traffic_acq       <- read.csv(file.path(web_dir, "traffic_channels.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
user_acq          <- read.csv(file.path(web_dir, "user_acquisition.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
geo_country       <- read.csv(file.path(web_dir, "Demographic_details_Country.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
tech_browser      <- read.csv(file.path(web_dir, "Tech_details_Browser.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
gsc_queries       <- read.csv(file.path(web_dir, "Queries_Organic_Google_Search.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
email_campaigns   <- read.csv(file.path(web_dir, "MM Email Campaigns.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
email_links       <- read.csv(file.path(web_dir, "Click Through Links from Email Campaigns - Sheet1.csv"), check.names = FALSE)

# Landing Page Columns
lpcol  <- "Landing page"
sessions_lp  <- "Sessions"
olpcol <- "Landing page + query string"
sessions_olp <- "Active users" 

# Channel Acquisition Columns
chan_sess  <- "Session primary channel group (Default Channel Group)"
sess_col   <- "Sessions"
chan_first <- first_col(user_acq,    c("First user primary channel group (Default Channel Group)","Default Channel Group"))
users_col  <- first_col(user_acq,    c("New users","Users","users"))

# GSC Queries Columns
qcol   <- "Organic Google Search query"
clicks <- "Organic Google Search clicks"

# Email Columns
camp_key_campaigns <- "Campaign Name"
sends_col <- "Sends"
camp_key_links     <- "Distribution"
urlcol_links       <- "Link"
clickcol_links     <- "Unique Clicks"

g_users   <- "Active users"
b_users   <- "Active users"
2. Core Funnel Analysis and Conversiondest_counts      <- trips    %>% count(tripdestination, name = "bookings") %>% arrange(desc(bookings))
source_counts    <- deposits %>% count(source,        name = "deposits") %>% arrange(desc(deposits))
monthly_deposits <- deposits %>% count(month,         name = "deposits") %>% arrange(month)

knitr::kable(head(dest_counts, 10), caption = "Top 10 Trip Destinations") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()
knitr::kable(head(source_counts, 15), caption = "Top Sources (Deposits)") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()
knitr::kable(monthly_deposits,        caption = "Monthly Deposits (2025)") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()

conv_by_source_dest <- joined %>%
filter(!is.na(dest_bucket)) %>%
count(source_bucket, dest_bucket, name = "count")

conv_pivot <- conv_by_source_dest %>%
tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = dest_bucket, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)

knitr::kable(conv_pivot, caption = "Conversion Matrix: Source × Destination Bucket") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()

heat_df <- conv_by_source_dest %>%
mutate(dest_bucket = factor(dest_bucket,
levels = c("Denali Expedition","Denali Prep","High-Altitude Expeditions",
"PNW Objectives","Training/Course","Treks","Other")))

ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = dest_bucket, y = source_bucket, fill = count)) +
geom_tile(color = "white") +
scale_fill_gradient(name = "Matches", low = "#f0f0f0", high = "#08306b") +
labs(title = "Conversion Matrix: Source Bucket × Destination Bucket",
x = "Destination Bucket", y = "Source Bucket")

denali_sources <- joined %>% filter(is_denali) %>%
count(source_bucket, name = "denali_matches") %>%
arrange(desc(denali_matches))

knitr::kable(denali_sources, caption = "Denali Matches by Source Bucket") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()

ageband_by_dest <- trips %>%
filter(!is.na(age_band)) %>%
count(dest_bucket, age_band, name = "n") %>%
group_by(dest_bucket) %>%
mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) %>%
ungroup()

knitr::kable(head(ageband_by_dest, 20), caption = "Age-band Share within Bucket (sample)") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()

ggplot(ageband_by_dest %>%
mutate(dest_bucket = fct_relevel(dest_bucket,
"Denali Expedition","Denali Prep","High-Altitude Expeditions",
"PNW Objectives","Training/Course","Treks","Other")),
aes(dest_bucket, pct, fill = age_band)) +
geom_col(position = "fill") +
scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
coord_flip() +
labs(title = "Age-band Share within Destination Buckets",
x = "Destination Bucket", y = "Share", fill = "Age Band")
3. Denali Propensity Scoringprospects <- trips %>%
transmute(email_norm, age, gender, country, dest_bucket, tripdestination) %>%
mutate(score = 0L) %>%
mutate(
score = score + ifelse(dest_bucket == "Denali Prep", 5L, 0L),
score = score + ifelse(dest_bucket == "High-Altitude Expeditions", 3L, 0L),
score = score + ifelse(dest_bucket == "PNW Objectives", 2L, 0L),
score = score + ifelse(dest_bucket == "Training/Course", 1L, 0L),
score = score + ifelse(!is.na(age) & age >= 30 & age <= 49, 2L, 0L),
score = score + ifelse(country %in% c("USA","Canada"), 1L, 0L)
)

prospect_scores <- prospects %>%
group_by(email_norm) %>%
summarise(
age_max = suppressWarnings(max(age, na.rm = TRUE)),
gender  = dplyr::first(gender),
country = dplyr::first(country),
buckets = paste(sort(unique(dest_bucket)), collapse = ", "),
score   = max(score, na.rm = TRUE),
.groups = "drop"
) %>%
arrange(desc(score))

top_100_prospects <- prospect_scores %>% slice_head(n = 100)

knitr::kable(head(top_100_prospects, 20), caption = "Top 100 Denali Propensity Prospects (first 20)") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()

ggplot(prospect_scores, aes(score)) +
geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
labs(title = "Denali Propensity Score Distribution",
x = "Propensity Score", y = "Count")

into_thin_air_n <- deposits %>%
filter(str_detect(tolower(source), "into thin air")) %>%
nrow()
cat("Into Thin Air mentions in deposits:", into_thin_air_n, "\n")
4. Web Traffic and Email Channel Analysis# Normalize paths and flags
landing$page_path         <- norm_path(landing[[lpcol]])
landing_organic$page_path <- norm_path(landing_organic[[olpcol]])
landing$is_denali         <- flag_denali(landing$page_path)
landing$is_feeder         <- flag_feeder(landing$page_path)
landing_organic$is_denali <- flag_denali(landing_organic$page_path)

# Calculate Denali share
denali_share_all <- with(aggregate(landing[[sessions_lp]], list(landing$is_denali), sum, na.rm=TRUE),
x[Group.1==TRUE] / sum(x))
denali_share_org <- sum(landing_organic[landing_organic$is_denali, sessions_olp], na.rm=TRUE) /
sum(landing_organic[[sessions_olp]], na.rm=TRUE)

cat("Denali landing share (ALL channels):  ", round(100*denali_share_all,1),  "%\n")
cat("Denali landing share (ORGANIC only): ", round(100*denali_share_org,1), "%\n")

# Channel Mix
mix_sess <- aggregate(traffic_acq[[sess_col]], list(channel=traffic_acq[[chan_sess]]), sum, na.rm=TRUE)
mix_user <- aggregate(user_acq[[users_col]],   list(channel=user_acq[[chan_first]]),   sum, na.rm=TRUE)

channels_compare <- merge(mix_sess, mix_user, by="channel", all=TRUE)
names(channels_compare) <- c("channel","sessions","new_users")

tot_sess <- sum(channels_compare$sessions,  na.rm=TRUE)
tot_new  <- sum(channels_compare$new_users, na.rm=TRUE)

channels_compare <- channels_compare %>%
mutate(session_ratio   = sessions  / tot_sess,
new_user_ratio  = new_users / tot_new,
lift_new_vs_sessions = new_user_ratio - session_ratio) %>%
arrange(desc(lift_new_vs_sessions))

knitr::kable(channels_compare, digits=3, caption="Channels: new-user lift vs session share") %>%
kableExtra::kable_styling()

# GSC Query Analysis
bucket_query <- function(q){
ql <- tolower(q)
if (grepl("denali", ql)) return("Denali")
if (grepl("mountain madness|mountainmadness| mm ", ql)) return("Brand")
if (grepl("baker|avy|avalanche|glacier|rainier|mountaineering", ql)) return("Feeder")
"General"
}

gsc_queries$bucket <- vapply(gsc_queries[[qcol]], bucket_query, FUN.VALUE=character(1))
gsc_summary <- aggregate(gsc_queries[[clicks]], list(bucket=gsc_queries$bucket), sum, na.rm=TRUE)
names(gsc_summary)[2] <- "clicks"
gsc_summary <- gsc_summary[order(-gsc_summary$clicks),]

knitr::kable(gsc_summary, caption="GSC clicks by intent bucket") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()

# Email Analysis
email_links$page_path <- norm_path(email_links[[urlcol_links]])
email_links$is_denali <- flag_denali(email_links$page_path)

denali_clicks <- aggregate(email_links[[clickcol_links]],
list(campaign=email_links[[camp_key_links]], is_denali=email_links$is_denali),
sum, na.rm=TRUE)
denali_clicks <- subset(denali_clicks, is_denali==TRUE)[,c("campaign","x")]
names(denali_clicks)[2] <- "denali_clicks"

email_denali <- merge(
email_campaigns[, c(camp_key_campaigns, sends_col, setdiff(names(email_campaigns), character(0)))],
denali_clicks, by.x=camp_key_campaigns, by.y="campaign", all.x=TRUE
) %>%
mutate(denali_clicks = ifelse(is.na(denali_clicks), 0, denali_clicks),
denali_click_rate = ifelse(get(sends_col)>0, denali_clicks / get(sends_col), NA_real_)) %>%
arrange(desc(denali_click_rate))

knitr::kable(head(email_denali, 10), caption="Top campaigns by Denali click rate") %>%
kableExtra::kable_styling()

# Geo/Tech Details
geo_top     <- geo_country[order(-geo_country[[g_users]]), ][1:min(15, nrow(geo_country)), ]
browser_top <- tech_browser[order(-tech_browser[[b_users]]),][1:min(10, nrow(tech_browser)),]

knitr::kable(geo_top,     caption="Top countries by users/sessions") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()
knitr::kable(browser_top, caption="Top browsers (watch for outliers)") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()
